metadata.description: Optional routing metadata. The reserved `artifactKey` value selects an artifact lineage and is limited to 200 characters.

tenantId.description: Development scope hint. In JWT mode, a supplied value must match the authenticated claim.

actorId.description: Development scope hint. In JWT mode, a supplied value must match the authenticated claim.

permissionScopes.description: Server-derived authorization context. Request-body values are ignored and replaced by authenticated scopes.
